answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks through quadratic stake slashing linked to network activity. Each node deposits cryptographic stake to harbor verifiable identities in the network grove. With each consensus pulse, identity claims are verified, burning staked collateral at a superlinear cost scaling as O(N^2) for N identities operated by one entity. This mathematical penalty imposes immense economic friction, rendering mass cloning computationally and financially prohibitive.
